comparison.objective: Insert a polarized battery and thread a flashlight cap fully; candidate adjusts two sensor mounts.
comparison.physical_skill: Close-clearance insertion plus repeated threaded cap regrasping versus partial screw loosening and feedback-guided linear registration.
comparison.success_condition: Correct battery polarity, cap ≥300° and within 1 mm of seated, stable 1 s; candidate requires two retained proximity states.
comparison.reason: Shared fastening and alignment primitives do not duplicate the calibration loop. Candidate screw/slot geometry and force limits remain unresolved.
